desc: Offline audit of late-October asahi kernel and Yuka t604x DT/input/NVMe/WiFi references against Wallace. Pin commits, map minimal deltas and regression gates; preserve ticket 6001 payload and daily baseline. No build or rig access required for completion.
author: astra
acceptance_criteria: Resolve immutable sources and actual corrected asahi-7.2.12-2 tag target; record merge versus submission status and retrieval gaps.
Compare J614s live ADT, DT domains/IRQs/reserved pins, NVMe/SART/controller-state fixes, HID and BRCM4388; preserve locally proven functionality.
Produce patch/dependency map and separate single-CPU regression candidate plan with rollback, keymap and config gates. Do not modify 6001 artifacts.
Define independent SMP fault-205 retest using original reproducer; exclude p3s and unrelated experiments. New builds/live runs need their own scoped follow-ons.
